import json
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    cols=set(c for r in g for c,x in enumerate(r) if x)
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r if x))
    for col in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col]
        top=min(r for r,c in cells)
        for r,c in cells: out[r-top+1][c]=col
    return out
print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
out=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
json.dump({'input':G['Test input'],'output':out},open('programs/task-54184fe1_cand.json','w'))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors=sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r if x))
    def top(col): return min(r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col)
    ref=top(8)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for col in colors:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col]
        for r,c in cells: out[r-top(col)+ref][c]=col
    return out
assert transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output']
assert transform(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output']
out=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
